Nuitka
======

MyWB is compiled with Nuitka.

Nuitka version: 4.1.3

Nuitka is developed by Kay Hayen.

All rights reserved.

The Nuitka compiler is licensed separately from MyWB. The Nuitka compiler is
not included in the MyWB application bundle. Nuitka-generated target code
uses the Nuitka Runtime Library under the additional permission reproduced in
LICENSE-RUNTIME.txt. That exception permits target code, including
proprietary applications, to be conveyed under terms chosen by the
application author.
